name: data-table
title: DataTable
description: Generic, sortable, expandable composite over <Table>. Operator-grade entity-list patterns: sortable headers (controlled OR uncontrolled), sticky header, expandable rows (multi default + expandMode='single' opt-in), row action menus via DropdownMenu, client-side pagination, loading skeleton, empty state. Generic over T (e.g. DataTable<Domain>). Virtualized mode (10K+ rows over @tanstack/react-virtual): fixed row heights, sticky header, mutually exclusive with pagination/expandable at the type level.
